clue.text: In leaving, closely examine odd range of colours

indicators.note: leaving says the word In departs from the word for closely examine

parts.note: to inspect is to examine closely
taken as written
rum is an old-fashioned word for odd or strange

explanation.surface: Someone told to scrutinise a peculiar set of colours while making an exit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In leaving' removes IN from INSPECT to leave SPECT.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectrum is the band of colours produced when light is split, as in a rainbow.

clue.text: Former church abandoning one sort of musical work for another

parts.note: past means former or bygone

indicators.note: abandoning says the church abbreviation is dropped from the musical work

parts.note: a chorale is a hymn tune, one kind of musical composition

explanation.surface: A one-time church gives up one kind of music in favour of a different kind.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition 'another' leans on the wordplay: it means another sort of musical work, following on from 'one sort of musical work'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastorale is a musical composition evoking rural life, a different sort of musical work from a chorale.

clue.text: Servicemen using signals to capture deserter?

indicators.note: to capture means the signals word surrounds and holds the deserter word

parts.note: cues are signals, as to an actor
a rat is one who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: Soldiers use signals to catch a runaway from the army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Servicemen' suggests the armed forces, but these men conduct church services.
explanation.definitionFit: Curates are assistant clergy who conduct church services, so they are humorously servicemen.

clue.text: Judge heads appeal for restoration of ship

indicators.note: heads means the judge word goes in front of the appeal word

parts.note: a ref, referee, judges a game
it is slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A judge leads a call for a ship to be restored.
explanation.definitionFit: A refit is an overhaul and re-equipping of a ship to restore it to service.

clue.text: Knocked over barrier, like the March Hare

indicators.note: knocked over in a down clue means the barrier word is turned upside down, read upwards

parts.note: a dam is a barrier holding back water

explanation.surface: A barrier toppled, as if by the March Hare from Alice in Wonderland.
explanation.definitionFit: The March Hare in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland is proverbially insane, hence 'mad as a March hare'.

clue.text: Grope around feebly at first, like Uriah Heep?

indicators.note: at first means take just the opening letter of feebly

parts.note: Uriah Heep, the obsequious clerk in Dickens's David Copperfield, constantly calls himself 'umble, dropping the H of humble

explanation.surface: Someone groping weakly, as cringing as the Dickens villain Uriah Heep.
explanation.definitionFit: To fumble is to grope clumsily for something with the hands.

clue.text: Aircraft controller knowing how messages may be transmitted?

parts.note: fly is British slang for knowing or sharp
telegrams were sent by wire

explanation.surface: An air traffic controller who understands how telegrams are sent.
explanation.definitionFit: Fly-by-wire is a system controlling an aircraft's surfaces through electronic signals instead of mechanical linkages.

clue.text: Prepared for exhibition, riding horses

definitions.meaning: a picture or specimen ... is fixed on a backing for display
... troops or police ride on horseback

explanation.definitionFit: Mounted describes both an item set up for display and someone sitting on a horse.

clue.text: House in which Wagnerian fire god keeps daughter

indicators.note: keeps means the god's name holds the daughter abbreviation inside

parts.note: Loge is the fire god in Wagner's Ring cycle

explanation.surface: A house where the fire god of Wagner's operas looks after his daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A lodge is a small house, such as a gatekeeper's house on an estate.

clue.text: Ruler son dipped in wood preservative

indicators.note: dipped in means the son letter goes inside the preservative word

parts.note: tar is used to preserve timber

explanation.surface: A ruler's son is plunged into a vat of wood preservative.
explanation.definitionFit: A tsar was the emperor of Russia, an absolute ruler.

clue.text: An old fogey's ruddy rhymes

definitions.meaning: a fogey is a fussy old-fashioned person
two words each rhyming with ruddy, joined together

explanation.definitionFit: A fuddy-duddy is a stuffy, old-fashioned person, and its two halves both rhyme with ruddy.

clue.text: Stuck-up Italian in vessel with flirt imbibing wine

indicators.note: in means the Italian abbreviation sits inside the vessel word

parts.note: a hoy is a small coastal sailing vessel
It is short for Italian vermouth

indicators.note: imbibing means the flirt word drinks in, contains, the wine word

parts.note: to toy with someone is to flirt with them
It is Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: A snooty Italian on a boat with a flirt who is drinking wine.
explanation.walkthrough: IT, short for Italian vermouth (as in gin and It), serves twice: once for 'Italian' and once for 'wine'.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoity-toity means haughty and snobbish, the same as stuck-up.

clue.text: From temporary home, right time to move

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: to move means these letters shift into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice that it is the right moment to leave a temporary home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to move' rearranges IN, R and TIME.
explanation.definitionFit: An interim arrangement is provisional, lasting only until something permanent is in place.

clue.text: Time engineers finally undertook arduous journey

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: finally means take only the closing letter of undertook

explanation.surface: Eventually the engineers set out on a hard journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long, difficult journey, especially on foot.

clue.text: Power is vested in father's type, one admits

parts.note: pa is father, so father's is pa's

indicators.note: is vested in means the power letter is placed inside the other words

parts.note: a sort is a type or kind
P is the abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: Authority is handed to a dad's sort of person, someone confesses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one admits' reads as a confession, but it describes a document that admits its holder.
explanation.definitionFit: A passport is a document that admits its holder into a foreign country.

clue.text: Canon involved with dire decree

indicators.note: involved means the letters are entangled and rearranged

explanation.surface: A church canon combined with a dreadful official order.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinance is an authoritative order or decree.

clue.text: Popular girl has note to write

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A well-liked girl has a message she needs to write.
explanation.definitionFit: To indite is an old word meaning to compose or write down.

clue.text: Their slides have seven positions? 76 were noted!

definitions.text: Their slides have seven positions? 76 were noted!

parts.words: Their slides have seven positions? 76 were noted!
parts.note: brass instruments whose sliding tube has seven playing positions, and the song from The Music Man boasts of seventy-six of them leading the big parade

explanation.definitionFit: A trombone's slide has seven positions, and '76 Trombones' is a famous song from The Music Man.

clue.text: Formally endorse honours degree

definitions.meaning: to back a motion formally at a meeting
a British honours degree class below a first

explanation.definitionFit: To second a motion is to support it formally; a second is also a class of British honours degree.

clue.text: Rest on top of damaged relievo

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of relievo are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Something resting on a relief carving that has been damaged.
explanation.walkthrough: A relievo is a relief sculpture.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlie something is to lie on top of it.

clue.text: Sandpiper on ridge of rock finds a secure hold

indicators.note: on in an across clue means the sandpiper word follows the rock word

parts.note: a reef is a ridge of rock near the water's surface
a knot is a kind of sandpiper, a wading bird

explanation.surface: A wading bird on a rocky ledge manages to grip firmly.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef knot is a double knot that holds securely and does not slip.

clue.text: Jack's dishonest conduct

parts.note: a jack in a pack of cards is also called a knave, so the behaviour typical of that card figure is roguery

explanation.definitionFit: Knavery is dishonest, roguish behaviour, the conduct of a knave, which is another name for the jack in cards.

clue.text: Turn back, about to meet this monster

indicators.note: back means the turn word is written backwards

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An instruction to turn round on meeting a monster.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogre is a man-eating giant or monster of folklore.

clue.text: Feeling of culpability, having sound security

indicators.note: sound means the word is heard, spoken aloud

parts.note: gilts are gilt-edged securities, British government bonds

explanation.surface: A sense of blame for having safe investments.
explanation.definitionFit: Guilt is the feeling of having done wrong, a sense of culpability.

clue.text: Wimpish doctor's taken in no earnings to engage another

indicators.note: taken in means the doctor letters go inside the no word

parts.note: nay means no
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

indicators.note: to engage means the earnings word holds the second doctor inside

parts.note: pay is earnings
another doctor, so MB again

explanation.surface: A feeble doctor is hired with no salary to take on a colleague.
explanation.definitionFit: Namby-pamby means weak and sentimental, spineless or wimpish.

clue.text: They may have their ups and downs in the playground

definitions.text: They may have their ups and downs in the playground

parts.words: They may have their ups and downs in the playground
parts.note: toys on a string that climb and drop as children play with them

explanation.definitionFit: Yo-yos are spools on a string that rise and fall, children's toys used at playtime.

clue.text: They're silly rhymes, whether one likes it or not

definitions.meaning: two words each rhyming with silly

definitions.text: whether one likes it or not

explanation.definitionFit: Willy-nilly means regardless of choice, and its two halves each rhyme with silly.

clue.text: Detective sergeant briefly leaves back of city shelter

indicators.note: leaves back of means the abbreviation departs from the end of the city name

parts.note: Leeds is a city in Yorkshire
DS is the abbreviation for detective sergeant

explanation.surface: A police officer quits the rear of a city for shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: The lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind.

clue.text: Large bird in larger nest

indicators.note: in means the bird is found within the words larger nest

explanation.surface: A big bird sits in a bigger nest.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne is the white-tailed sea eagle, a large bird of prey.

clue.text: A goddess consumed chicken inside

indicators.note: inside means the chicken word goes within the consumed word

parts.note: ate means consumed
a hen is a chicken

explanation.surface: A deity ate a meal with chicken in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek goddess of wisdom, also spelt Athena.

clue.text: Writer endlessly resists state intervening

indicators.note: intervening means the state word comes between the remaining letters
endlessly means drop the first and last letters of resists

parts.note: to state is to say

explanation.surface: A writer who keeps resisting interference by the state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a noun, the government, but it is the verb meaning to say.
explanation.definitionFit: An essayist is a writer of essays.
